正午时分，阳光透过树木的枝叶，洒落在了位于树干底部，一块外表圆润的灰色石头上。
“啊，这雨可算停了。”
阳光的温暖唤醒了沉睡的陈阳。
“这次睡了，嗯...五天。”
每当下雨天，陈阳就会陷入沉睡，因为他不喜欢雨天潮湿的气息。
雨水和雾气会让原本清澈的灵气变得潮湿。
陈阳看向四周，依旧是不变的景色。
“算起来，这是来到这个世界的第二十个年头了吧。”
前世经历了近半年无休高强度工作后，陈阳终于在那个疲惫的夜晚获得了解脱。
一觉醒来，就已经躺在了这里。
但是他穿越的身份稍微有亿点奇葩。
非人非兽，是一块石头。
二十年前，这块石头因为灵气的滋养，竟意外诞生了神智，陈阳的意识便在那刻入住了进来。
和所有穿越者一样，在一开始，陈阳的心情是十分激动的。
因为灵气的存在，他知道这个世界是能够修仙的。
同时作为穿越者，正常来说，都是会有外挂傍身。
所以在最初的几日，陈阳一直在研究自己的挂到底藏在了哪里。
面板？没有。
统子？也没出现。

附身的大帝元魂？那更不可能有了。
时间一天天过去，陈阳终于确定。
外挂，大抵是没有了吧。
自己只是一个运气好，生了神智的石头。
除了能够吐纳灵气，其他什么都做不了。
连最基本的移动都不行，只能静静的躺在这里。
认清现实后，陈阳并没有显得多么沮丧和不甘。
相反，他觉得这个新身份还挺不错，很适合自己。
想想前世的遭遇，无休止的加班，领导的pua和大饼，贷款的重担，亲戚朋友自顾自的对他抱有期待。
这样的生活让他感到窒息，甚至一度有了轻生的念头。
如今变成了石头，就在不用为这些乱七八糟的事情烦恼。
只需要每天吐纳灵气，累了就睡觉。
简单、舒坦且美好。
所以，从某种程度上来说，变成一块躺平的石头，很符合陈阳期望的状态。
他没用多久便完全接纳了自己的新身份。
然后这么一躺，真的就躺了二十年。
最开始，他每天清醒的时间只有不到两个小时，时间一到就会犯困陷入沉睡。
后来随着长年累月吐纳吸收灵气，保持清醒的时间也逐渐增长。
到现在，他已经能够做到连着十多天不睡觉，也能够保持意识清醒。
二十年里，他已经记不得看见多少次妖兽相食，灵鸟互猎，鬼怪相吞的场景。

若是以前，那个习惯了和谐社会的陈阳，肯定会觉得这个世界的生存法则太过残酷。
但现在，经过了岁月的洗礼，陈阳看到这些厮杀，心境已没有任何波澜。
“世道就是如此。”
“不吃，就会饿死。”

At noon, the sun shines through the branches and leaves of the trees and falls on a round gray stone at the bottom of the trunk.
"Ah, the rain has finally stopped."
The warmth of the sun awakened Chen Yang from his deep sleep.
"I slept this time for, um... five days."
Whenever it rains, Chen Yang will fall into a deep sleep because he doesn't like the moist smell of rainy days.
Rain and fog will make the originally clear spiritual energy become damp.
Chen Yang looked around and saw the same scenery.
"In total, this is probably the twentieth year since I came to this world."
After nearly half a year of non-stop high-intensity work in his previous life, Chen Yang finally found relief on that tiring night.
When I woke up, I was already lying here.
But his identity in time travel is a little weird.
Neither human nor beast, just a stone.
Twenty years ago, this stone accidentally gave birth to sanity due to the nourishment of spiritual energy, and Chen Yang's consciousness came in at that moment.
Like all time travellers, Chen Yang was very excited at the beginning.
Because of the existence of spiritual energy, he knew that it was possible to cultivate immortality in this world.
At the same time, as a time traveler, normally there will be cheats around.
So in the first few days, Chen Yang had been studying where his secret was hidden.
panel? No.
Tongzi? Didn't show up either.
The possessed soul of the Great Emperor? That's even more impossible.
Time passed day by day, and Chen Yang was finally sure.
Plug-ins are probably gone.
I am just a lucky stone born with sanity.
Apart from being able to breathe out spiritual energy, he can't do anything else.
He couldn't even move the most basic way, so he could only lie here quietly.
After recognizing the reality, Chen Yang did not look so depressed or unwilling.
On the contrary, he felt that this new identity was quite good and suited him very well.
Thinking about what happened in his previous life, the endless overtime work, the boss's pua and big pie, the burden of loans, relatives and friends who have high expectations for him.
This kind of life made him feel suffocated, and he even had thoughts of committing suicide.
Now that I have turned into stone, I don’t have to worry about these messy things.
Just breathe out the spiritual energy every day and go to bed when you are tired.
Simple, comfortable and beautiful.
Therefore, to a certain extent, turning into a flat stone is in line with Chen Yang's desired state.
It didn't take long for him to fully accept his new identity.
Then I lay like this for twenty years.
In the beginning, he was awake for less than two hours a day, and when the time was up, he would fall asleep.
Later, as I breathed out and absorbed spiritual energy over the years, the time I could stay awake gradually increased.
Up to now, he has been able to stay awake for more than ten days without sleeping and still be conscious.
In the past twenty years, he could not remember how many times he had seen scenes of monsters and beasts eating each other, spiritual birds hunting each other, and ghosts devouring each other.
In the past, Chen Yang, who was accustomed to a harmonious society, would definitely feel that the rules of survival in this world were too cruel.
But now, after years of baptism, Chen Yang saw these fights and his mood no longer wavered.
"That's the way the world is."
"If you don't eat, you will starve to death."
